results.controlIntent: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to: a. Perform configuration management during system, component, or service [Selection (one or more): design; development; implementation; operation; disposal]; b. Control the integrity of changes to [Assignment: organization-defined configuration items under configuration management]; manage the integrity of those changes; and document the integrity of those changes; c. Implement only organization-approved changes to the system, component, or service; d. Record approved changes to the system, component, or service; and record the potential security and privacy impacts of such changes; and e. Track security flaws and flaw resolution within the system, component, or service; and report findings to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel].

judgment.rationale:
Evidence from two sources reveals critical change-control failures for the churn-predictor-v1 model/endpoint:

1. **Initial deployment (CreateEndpoint, 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z)** — The endpoint was created approximately 2 hours *after* the registry approval timestamp (2025-12-01T09:00:00Z). This single event is temporally consistent with an approved-change workflow (SA-10.r4.c/d satisfied for this event).

2. **Hotfix update (UpdateEndpoint, 2026-03-15T14:22:00Z)** — The endpoint was updated to config `churn-predictor-v1-hotfix` by the same IAM user with **no corresponding model registry entry**. The model registry contains only version 1 (approved 2025-12-01). This means:
   - The change was implemented without a recorded organizational approval (violates SA-10.r4.c).
   - No approval artifact or integrity record exists for this change (violates SA-10.r4.b and SA-10.r4.d).
   - The hotfix bypasses the registry-based integrity gate entirely.

3. **Security flaw tracking (SA-10.r4.e)** — Neither collector returned any evidence of security flaw tracking, resolution records, or reporting to designated personnel.

The unapproved hotfix deployment is a direct, high-confidence violation of the control's core requirement to implement *only* organization-approved changes and to record those changes with their security/privacy impact assessments.
gaps: No evidence of security flaw tracking, resolution records, or reporting mechanisms (SA-10.r4.e) — would require a separate ticketing/ITSM or SageMaker Experiments data source.
No evidence of a security/privacy impact assessment for any change — would require change-request documentation (e.g., JIRA, ServiceNow).

The hotfix config 'churn-predictor-v1-hotfix' has no registry entry; human attestation or a separate config-management system would be needed to determine whether an out-of-band approval process exists.
No evidence of disposal-phase configuration management controls.

payload.note: Deployed 2h BEFORE registry approval at 09:00 — change control not satisfied
Hotfix deploy — no corresponding registry entry found
